verdict.rationale: Bugbot fires automatically on a fixed event (every PR update / new PR). Users can write rules that shape what it does: repo-level `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` guidelines, org-wide rules in Bugbot Automations, and natural-language 'Smart' rules for when to use low, default or high effort. However, the trigger event and the action (a code review) are fixed rather than user-definable; one community user needed a GitHub Action to get custom on-request triggering. missing for 10: user-defined event types and conditions, configurable actions beyond review comments, detailed docs on what Bugbot Automations can trigger, independent corroboration of rule-driven automation.
